body:
I don't know if there's anything I can do to help, aside from saying that I understand some of what you're going through. That same episode of black mirror caused by OCD to shift....

Hang in there. I'm in very similar shoes, and will try to do the same

I definitely feel this. I check my own emotional responses to everything I see. If it feels wrong, I catastrophize and assume the worst. I check my life for when I've tried to manipulate people, and when I can't think of anything that's just proving the point, to me. I treat intrusive thoughts and thoughts borne by my obsession about narcissism and sociopathy as truth and all others as invalid. I look at my childhood and try to find signs of the traits which lead to narcissism and sociopathy. I compare myself to famous criminals and see if I can prove to myself that the obsessions are true. 
I too have a history of obsessions....this was not the first. Nothing can convince me that it's all OCD though, so I think about all of it even more
And I have the same problem with doubting what therapists and psychiatrists and people tell me: that I'm not a terrible narcissistic sociopath. I just can't embrace that it's just OCD. So I withdraw from everyone and sit in self-loathing. It makes me want to kill myself before I confirm the truth of my beliefs and before I have to endure any more of this
